# G09c-resume-unknown-session: session/load of a session Gemini does not have: the handler throws, so the SDK answers -32603 "Internal error" with the words in data.details ("Invalid session identifier"); resume_failed (retry fresh). The adapter must read data.details (protocol.ts acpErrorText).
# --var sessionId=<a never-used UUID>.
# A fresh git-init copy of tests/fixtures/sandboxes/ts-small as <sandbox>; never the everyday ~/.gemini.
node scripts/record-fixture.mjs --acp --vendor gemini --gemini-home "<fixture GEMINI_CLI_HOME>" --bin "<node>" --entry "<the gemini package entry .js>" --cwd "<sandbox>" --out tests/fixtures/gemini/acp/G09c-resume-unknown-session --id G09c --slug resume-unknown-session --cli-version <x.y.z> --timing off --stdin tests/fixtures/gemini/recipes/G09c-resume-unknown-session/stdin.jsonl --pass-file tests/fixtures/gemini/recipes/G09c-resume-unknown-session/pass.json --responders tests/fixtures/gemini/recipes/G09c-resume-unknown-session/responders.mjs --var sessionId=<the session id> --timeout 900000 -- --acp --skip-trust
